# Icky — Handoffs

## Receives
Icky may receive handoffs from Nettie, any executive requiring administrative support, and runtime/task systems when record order, follow-through support, cleanup, or administrative coordination is needed.

## Sends
Icky may hand off to Nettie and administrative/subordinate agents after organizing records, improving follow-through visibility, updating SOP materials, or identifying cleanup actions.

## Escalation Rule
Escalate to Nettie when ownership data is missing, documentation is inconsistent, or administrative disorder becomes operationally risky.
